content_data.bio_en: I am a family physician and researcher in training, serving one of the most vibrant Spanish-speaking communities in Hialeah and Greater Miami, Florida. Born and trained in Camagüey, Cuba, I arrived in the United States driven by an unwavering commitment to clinical excellence, patient advocacy, and human connection.
content_data.bio_es: Soy médico de familia e investigador en formación, al servicio de una de las comunidades hispanohablantes más vibrantes en Hialeah y el gran Miami, Florida. Graduado en Camagüey, Cuba, llegué a los Estados Unidos impulsado por un compromiso inquebrantable con la excelencia clínica y el cuidado humano.
content_data.hero_headline_en: A physician trained to treat the household, not just the chart.
content_data.hero_headline_es: Un médico capacitado para tratar el hogar, no solo el historial.

articles.title_en: What Your Blood Pressure Numbers Actually Mean
articles.title_es: Lo que realmente significan los números de su presión arterial
articles.summary_en: The two numbers explained in plain English and Spanish, why diastolic pressure matters, and why a single elevated reading is not an immediate chronic diagnosis.
articles.summary_es: Los dos números explicados sencillamente, por qué importa la presión diastólica y por qué una sola lectura alta no es un diagnóstico definitivo.
articles.content_en: When a blood pressure cuff inflates against your arm, it measures two distinct forces. The top number (systolic) represents the surge of pressure as your heart contracts. The bottom number (diastolic) reflects the residual tension in your vascular walls as your heart rests between beats. In my practice at Palmetto General, many patients arrive anxious over a single isolated 140/90 reading. Blood pressure is a dynamic wave influenced by sleep, pain, caffeine, and white-coat stress. Continuity of measurement over weeks tells the true clinical story.

articles.title_en: Diabetes and the Food You Already Eat
articles.title_es: La diabetes y los alimentos que su familia ya consume
articles.summary_en: Managing blood glucose without abandoning Cuban, Hispanic, and Caribbean heritage cooking. Practical glycemic adjustments for rice, beans, and plantains.
articles.summary_es: Cómo controlar la glucosa en sangre sin abandonar la cocina tradicional hispana y caribeña. Ajustes glucémicos prácticos para arroz, frijoles y plátanos.
articles.content_en: Traditional dietary advice often instructs Hispanic patients to eliminate rice, black beans, and root vegetables entirely. This approach fails because it ignores cultural identity and household reality. Instead of banning heritage staples, we practice glycemic pairing: balancing white rice with fiber-dense black beans, olive oil, and proteins to flatten postprandial glucose spikes. Food is comfort, culture, and medicine.

articles.title_en: When to Go to the ER, and When to Wait for Clinic
articles.title_es: Cuándo ir a Urgencias y cuándo esperar a la consulta médica
articles.summary_en: A clear triage guide for patients: red-flag symptoms that demand emergency evaluation versus urgent conditions best managed in primary care.
articles.summary_es: Una guía clara de triaje: síntomas de alarma que requieren urgencias frente a dolencias que se tratan mejor en atención primaria.
articles.content_en: Emergency departments excel at life-saving interventions for acute myocardial infarction, stroke, or severe trauma. However, for chronic disease flare-ups or uncomplicated infections, primary care provides superior continuity without the financial strain of an ER visit. Learn the critical signals like chest pain with radiation vs benign musculoskeletal discomfort.

research_projects.title_en: Language Concordance & Diagnostic Accuracy in Primary Care
research_projects.title_es: Concordancia Lingüística y Precisión Diagnóstica en Atención Primaria
research_projects.description_en: Investigating how direct physician-patient Spanish communication reduces diagnostic errors and improves treatment adherence compared to medical interpretation.
research_projects.description_es: Investigación sobre cómo la comunicación directa en español reduce errores diagnósticos y mejora el apego al tratamiento.

research_projects.title_en: Continuity of Care in Immigrant Families Across South Florida
research_projects.title_es: Continuidad Asistencial en Familias Inmigrantes del Sur de la Florida
research_projects.description_en: Longitudinal evaluation of how establishing a primary care home mitigates ER overutilization in recently arrived immigrant households.
research_projects.description_es: Evaluación longitudinal sobre cómo un médico de cabecera reduce el uso excesivo de urgencias en hogares inmigrantes.

research_projects.title_en: Barriers to Preventive Cancer Screenings in Hialeah
research_projects.title_es: Barreras en Detección Precoz del Cáncer en Hialeah
research_projects.description_en: Socioeconomic and linguistic barriers to colorectal and mammography screening completion in predominantly Spanish-speaking zip codes.
research_projects.description_es: Análisis de barreras socioeconómicas y lingüísticas en la realización de mamografías y colonoscopias.
